rule: Nonnegative baseline conductances/gains multiplied by strictly positive exp(theta); coupling, gate speed and calcium decay time remain positive. Exact baseline zeros stay zero. No uniform relative upper/lower percentage bound.
center: theta=0 means original manual cell bank
scope: 23 shared cell-type groups x9 fields; original frozen cells and all other fields unchanged
unmeasured_upper_limits: Unknown; no invented upper cap. Numerical nonfinite loss/gradient/scale aborts without counting an update.
